set.body:
Source: review findings in TaskRuntime.scala:272 and 344.

Problem:
WorkerEventSink I/O failure can abort a run after the task produced a valid result or while publishing it, allowing an observability channel to suppress the authoritative result envelope.

Acceptance:
- Make event delivery bounded and non-authoritative, consistent with scheduler telemetry.
- Ensure sink failure, timeout, or cancellation cannot replace a valid task result or suppress atomic publication.
- Retain bounded class/code-only diagnostics about event-delivery failure without leaking task data.
- Add fault-injection tests at Started, task failure, result publication, and terminal event boundaries.
set.title: P6f.9: Decouple worker event delivery from result authority
